items.label: Perfect Size
items.value: Designed by women, for women. The CLOKARS crossbody purse are medium and roomy for daily essentials. Total 4 zipper compartments, the main compartment with 1 zipper pocket and 1 slip pocket. The front compartment with 8 RFID pocket for your cards and 1 slip pocket. It's the right size to fits your every day needs, such as phone, keys, sunglasses, wallet and lipstick...

items.label: Premium Material
items.value: Our bags are made from high-quality Vegan leather materials. This style has a soft leather body, nylon lining and metal hardware. Water-resistant & easy to clean

items.label: Versatile Carrying Options
items.value: Coming with lightweight & wide guitar strap, which is adjustable and very comfy and does not get you tired from having it on your shoulder. You can wear it over your shoulder or across your body depending on where you go. Very suitable for travel

items.label: Classy for Summer & Winter Outfits
items.value: Simple but elegant or casual look & color combination works for multiple seasons. The white color goes well with many summer outfits, and brown color fit for winter outfits. This crossbody travel bag is a great complement to any outfit

items.label: Gift for All Occasions
items.value: Our cute crossbody bag is not only a practical bag, but also a great gift for milestone moments, such as Birthdays, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Mother's Day, Wedding and Party...
